chat.title: Chat
chat.noConversations: No conversations yet. Ask your first question.
chat.emptyBody: Questions are answered from the source code alone, with the evidence next to the answer. Choose the scope above if you only care about some applications.
chat.question: Your question
chat.placeholder: Ask about the code, an application or how applications relate…
chat.composerHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
chat.failed: The answer could not be completed.
chat.fileChanged: This file changed after it was indexed.
chat.someUnverified: Some sources could not be matched to evidence retrieved for this answer. Check them before relying on it.
chat.feedbackAndProposalSaved: Thanks, your feedback was saved and the proposed correction waits for a maintainer to approve it.
chat.proposeToggle: Also propose this as a correction to an application's catalog
chat.proposeHelp: It changes nothing until a maintainer approves it. Once approved, the text is kept in that section and used as authoritative when the catalog is regenerated.
